title: ALINA Book to FATHER Knowledge Factory
purpose: Translate, semantically decompose and convert a bounded technical book scope into a traceable knowledge package for FATHER.

steps.name: Register source, edition, license notes and bounded scope
Preserve original structure and source locators
Produce traceable Russian translation for the bounded scope
Build semantic outline by ideas rather than page order only
Extract and normalize glossary of terms and concepts
Extract source-supported claims, limitations and recommendations
Extract applications and use cases
Extract examples and reconstruct their purpose/input/procedure/output
Extract algorithms, procedures and decision branches
Extract author conclusions and keep them separate from ALINA conclusions
Generate cross-chapter combinations and engineering hypotheses
Generate operational checklists from validated knowledge
Create normalized knowledge atoms with provenance
Map atoms to FATHER capabilities
Identify ADR/block/chassis/policy/test targets
Identify gaps, contradictions and missing evidence
External repository and implementation scouting
Compare REUSE/ADAPT/BUILD/REJECT candidates
Critic review of translation and semantic coverage
Record ALINA learning feedback and corrections
FATHER knowledge package handoff

rules: Translation must preserve source meaning and locator.
No glossary term without source locator.
Source-derived content and ALINA inference must be separately labeled.
Author conclusion and ALINA conclusion are different entities.
Combination hypotheses are never presented as source claims.
Do not perform repository selection before extraction and semantic decomposition are closed.
One book cannot by itself make an architecture decision production-ready.
Conflicts and rejected knowledge remain recorded.
No checklist item without a traceable knowledge or algorithm source.
No production claim without test and evidence.
